headline: Indo Borax & Chemicals files financial results for the quarter ended September 2026
summary: Indo Borax & Chemicals Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the period ending September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. Retail investors can review the company's revenue, margins, and net profit performance for the quarter in the regulatory filing. This regular disclosure helps shareholders track the operational health and earnings trajectory of the company. Such filings allow investors to make informed decisions regarding their holdings based on verified financial data.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data allows shareholders to track financial health.

headline: Indo Borax amends Kronox acquisition agreement to remove seller lock-in
hook: Deal terms change for Indo Borax
summary: Indo Borax & Chemicals has amended its acquisition deal regarding Kronox. The revision specifically removes the seller lock-in clause from the original agreement. No further financial details or completion timelines were provided in the filing. Retail investors holding Indo Borax should note the structural change to the transaction.
why_it_matters: Seller lock-in removed in Indo Borax acquisition deal.

headline: Indo Borax & Chemicals issues postal ballot notice
hook: Postal ballot notice sent to shareholders
summary: Indo Borax & Chemicals Limited has informed the stock exchange regarding the issuance of a notice for a postal ballot to its shareholders. The filing is a standard procedural corporate disclosure required for passing specific resolutions remotely. Retail investors holding the stock should note upcoming voting items, though no financial impact is disclosed in this filing.
why_it_matters: Voting items ahead for Indo Borax shareholders.
